citation: Du J. A novel intrusion detection system for IIoT in 5G networks using attention-augmented federated learning and lightweight transformer architectures. Scientific Reports 16:23974, 2026. doi:10.1038/s41598-026-54748-x

A1.evidence: 'The data is divided into about 70% for training, 15% for validation, and 15% for testing among scattered devices'; 'a 5-fold cross-validation technique was utilized in the training phase' (Simulation results).

A2.evidence: Single record input: 'The resulting 1D feature vector is reshaped into a 2D tensor (e.g., a 24x24 grayscale-like image)' (Feature mapping and modality conversion); no sliding windows over records.

A3.evidence: 'Numerical features are normalized to the interval [0, 1] employing Min-Max normalization' (Data cleaning and normalization); fit scope not stated (only KMeans-SMOTE stated 'exclusively on the training subset').

A5.evidence: Baselines MobileNetV3-SVM, LSTM, ViT, VGG-19 introduced with refs [37]-[40]; no statement that they used the same rounds/epochs.

A6.evidence: 'The proposed model is evaluated against baseline methods, including MobileNetV3-SVM[37], LSTM[38], ViT[39], and VGG-19[40]'; Table 15 paired t-tests vs each baseline imply authors' own runs. Not explicitly stated.

A7.evidence: Tables 5/7: Recall, Precision, F1-Score, MSE, RMSE, MAE; text also Accuracy and AUC; no MCC/balanced accuracy/G-mean.

A8.evidence: 'the pre-processed dataset is partitioned into non-IID subsets using a label-based skewed distribution'; alpha from 0.1 to 1.0 (Table 10).

A9.evidence: 'each experiment was repeated five times with varying random seeds ... mean values with their associated standard deviation (+- SD)'; Table 15 'Summary of statistical comparison (paired t-test)'.

A10.evidence: Table 14 'Cross-dataset evaluation results': model 'trained exclusively on Edge-IIoTset and subsequently assessed on ToN-IoT without undergoing retraining'.

A11.evidence: Data availability: 'available from the corresponding author on reasonable request'; no code link.

notes: A1: 70/15/15 split method not stated; coded random because 5-fold CV is stated (guidance counts k-fold as random) - flag. A6 inferred from paired t-tests against baselines and baselines evaluated on both datasets; baselines appear centralized; no sentence says re-run or copied - flag for second coder. A10: ToN-IoT is also used to train separate models in the main experiments, but the Table 14 model was trained only on Edge-IIoTset. Table 5/7 baseline values carry no SD.
